hypothesis: Adding only a zero-initialized record-conditioned softmax gate over the 96 WKB Helmholtz bins, and supervising the exact gated coefficients consumed by synthesis, will reduce the parent's all-saved Marmousi relative L2 from 0.053137 to no more than 0.04 while retaining all-saved aggregate, uniform, and layered relative L2 no greater than 0.04 on the same three project-train records within 4000 updates.
expected_mechanism: The parent fits low frequencies substantially better than middle and high frequencies (relative L2 0.0373 versus 0.3359 and 0.4150). A zero-initialized linear map from each record's pooled rendered features to 96 softmax logits starts as an exact identity, then permits record-specific spectral emphasis without changing the analytic WKB time basis or exact-time query invariance. Applying the gate before coefficient loss gives the new parameters a direct gradient.

single_conceptual_variable.name: record_conditioned_frequency_attention
single_conceptual_variable.parent: independent 96-bin WKB coefficient head without frequency attention
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: same head multiplied by a zero-initialized record-conditioned 96-bin softmax gate
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: parent checkpoint, width 128, depth 8, spectral rank 112, modes 32, local-field channels [1,1,2,2], 96 bins, WKB phase, coefficient supervision, disabled legacy causal gate and free-surface factor, AdamW learning rates, three train records, seed 372, exact stored-time axis and metric implementation

primary_metric: all-saved relative L2 on the same project-train uniform/layered/marmousi triplet

failure_signal.static: any non-identity update-0 prediction, missing frequency-gate gradient, or identical gate weights across distinct records after a nonzero conditioned perturbation
failure_signal.pilot: no reduction in the fixed-panel worst-family gate score by update 500
failure_signal.formal: all-saved aggregate or any family remains above 0.04 at the selected checkpoint
failure_signal.interpretation_if_rejected: Record-level spectral reweighting is not the missing capacity. Stop multiplicative head-gate variants and return to a coarse-propagator residual or structurally nonlocal frequency mapper.

rollback: Preserve r18 and r20 artifacts. If r20 is rejected, do not open validation or test_id and do not continue frequency-gate tuning.
